caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized objects and patterns on a light beige background. The objects predominantly consist of floral and bird motifs rendered in outline with various colors, including brown, orange, blue, green, and black. Central to the composition is a figure resembling an angel or person with wings, outlined in brown and filled with orange, blue, and green lines. Surrounding this figure are four flower shapes with round petals, each outlined in brown and filled with yellow and orange centers. Around the flower motifs are several curved leaf or feather shapes in alternating orange, blue, and green hues. The upper portion of the drawing contains two large bell-shaped flowers joined by short stems with pairs of leaves, and two pairs of bird-like figures facing outward. The lower part of the drawing mirrors the arrangement with more floral and leaf motifs, including two leafy sprays on either side. A palette of nine small color samples is present at the bottom of the page. All lines and forms are delineated with dashed or stitched textures. The objects and motifs are spaced out and do not overlap, giving the composition an organized, grid-like structure.
title: Wall Decoration
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
